name: Endou Yayoi
source:
Yayoi is a member of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and Makoto Narumi's squad in the Moon Demon Company.
 
She is the kind-hearted peace keeper of the belligerent Narumi squad.

Contrary to her quiet looks, she is brave and has a firm attitude when confronting a vampire. 

[From [url=http://owarinoseraph.wikia.com/wiki/Yayoi_Endo]Owari no Seraph Wiki[/url]]
